subject: PioneerHealth exec workshop — on-site playbook & presenter assignments
messages:
From: Katie Moreno <katie@pioneerhealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: mruiz@hiltonevents.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — onsite logistics

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for stepping in to lead the onsite workshop for PioneerHealth on Aug 10. We want to finalize the agenda and prep materials this week so our execs have time to review. High level asks:
- Can you confirm which Redwood presenters will own the product demo (30m) and the SRE/infra deep-dive (20m)?
- We need a 1-page pre-read for execs by next Tue (Jul 27) — can you own distribution?
- Venue asks: AV mic counts and breakout room layout — looping in Marco at Hilton.

Appreciate it — Katie

Attachments: PioneerHealth_EventBrief.pdf (stub)
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Katie Moreno <katie@pioneerhealth.com>, mruiz@hiltonevents.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PioneerHealth exec workshop — on-site playbook & presenter assignments

Thanks Katie — tagging our leads and proposing assignments below. Quick plan: iterate agenda today, finalize pre-read outline by Wed, and lock slides by Fri.

Proposed presenter assignments (first pass):
- Product demo (30m): Marissa Cole — demo owner, will bring customer examples and roadmap callouts.
- SRE/Infra deep dive (20m): Vivek Kulkarni — focus on latency/cost levers and private deployment options.
- Strategy + outcomes (15m): Grace O'Connor — co-present with me for the exec ask and success metrics.

Marissa / Vivek / Grace — can you reply with confirmation, any co-presenters, and a single slide summary (3 bullets) by Thu EOD?

I will assemble the 1-pager pre-read and circulate draft by Tue (Jul 27). Marco — can you confirm AV (3 handheld mics, 2 lavs, projector + confidence monitor) and the attached room diagram is feasible?

Thanks — Lauren
Senior Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Katie Moreno <katie@pioneerhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PioneerHealth exec workshop — on-site playbook & presenter assignments

Confirming — I can own the 30m product demo. Plan:
- 5m quick context + customer pain points
- 15m demo (live) hitting latency/cost tradeoffs and dedicated vs hosted flows
- 10m Q&A + customer success success metrics

Co-presenters: Rishi Malhotra will join for the Q&A to cover procurement/contract questions. I'll upload a single-slide summary to the shared drive (link below) by Thu.

Attachments: slides_demo_outline.docx (stub)
Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_pioneer_playbook
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Katie Moreno <katie@pioneerhealth.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PioneerHealth exec workshop — on-site playbook & presenter assignments

I can take the infra deep-dive. Draft outline:
- 5m architecture recap (private vs hosted lanes)
- 10m performance & cost levers (quantization, batching, caching) with benchmarks
- 5m operational readiness + SLOs and fallback policies

I'll prepare a 1-slide summary and a 2-page appendix with the benchmark table. Sharing Day0_run_of_show.xlsx after I add the timing windows.

Note for the team: we should include a brief fallback demo (2-3 slides) in case the live demo hits throttling — helps maintain flow.

-Vivek
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Katie Moreno <katie@pioneerhealth.com>, James Turner <james.turner@pioneerhealth.com>

Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PioneerHealth exec workshop — on-site playbook & presenter assignments

Katie/James — draft agenda attached (see Day0_run_of_show.xlsx). Highlights:
- 09:00 — Welcome & objectives (10m) — Lauren + Grace
- 09:10 — Product context & demo (30m) — Marissa (Rishi on Q&A)
- 09:45 — Coffee break (15m)
- 10:00 — Infra deep-dive (20m) — Vivek
- 10:25 — Breakouts (45m) — two rooms: Strategy and Ops
- 11:15 — Exec wrap & ask (15m) — Lauren + Grace

Pre-read plan: I'm attaching the first draft (PioneerHealth_PreRead_v1.pdf). It is a one-pager with objectives, agenda, and the exec ask. Please review and send edits by Fri Jul 24 EOD so I can prepare the final version for distribution on Mon Jul 27.

Marco — also confirming room layout in the attached diagram. If Hilton can confirm AV counts by EOD Wed we'll be set.

Best,
Lauren
